paper.title_en: Emergent Scaling Symmetry and Universal Interior Criticality of Scalarized Black Holes
paper.abstract_en: The interiors of spontaneously scalarized charged black holes exhibit a tower of universality classes, including the previously reported $1/2$ scaling. We show that their near-critical collapse is governed by an emergent scaling symmetry at the would-be Cauchy horizon. This symmetry renders the interior dynamics autonomous, model-independent, and exactly integrable, realizing first-kind self-similarity rather than Choptuik-type second-kind criticality. It also yields a ``seesaw amplification'': an arbitrarily small exterior hair produces an arbitrarily large interior response. The amplification obeys an amplitude identity relating three independently measurable quantities. The singularity exponent equals the critical exponent of the exterior scalar charge. These relations connect the exterior phase transition to the approach to the interior singularity through the scaling dynamics near the would-be Cauchy horizon.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究自发标量化带电黑洞内部的临界坍缩，提出在拟柯西视界处出现的新生标度对称性，给出内区动力学的自治性、精确可积性以及第一类自相似（区别于Choptuik型第二类临界性），并给出外部毛发与内部响应的“跷跷板放大”及振幅恒等式，把外部相变与内部奇点趋近联系起来。主题属广义相对论基础与黑洞内部结构，理论深度与新颖性较高，摘要结构清晰、可直接判断价值，值得点击细读。
decision.title_zh: 标量化黑洞的新生标度对称性与普适内部临界性
decision.abstract_zh: 自发标量化带电黑洞的内部展现出多重普适类构成的塔结构，其中包括此前报道的 $1/2$ 标度。我们表明，其近临界坍缩由拟柯西视界处的新生标度对称性所支配。该对称性使内部动力学自治、与模型无关且精确可积，实现的是第一类自相似，而非 Choptuik 型的第二类临界性。它还给出一种“跷跷板放大”：任意小的外部毛发产生任意大的内部响应。该放大服从一个联系三个可独立测量量的振幅恒等式。奇点指数等于外部标量荷的临界指数。这些关系通过拟柯西视界附近的标度动力学，将外部相变与趋近内部奇点的过程联系起来。
